method: built-in image_gen tool; one generation call per distinct room; PNG outputs converted to JPEG with ImageMagick at quality 91; generated originals retained under CODEX_HOME/generated_images

night-drive.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide landscape ambience-room scene plate for a listening experience
Primary request: painterly environmental concept art of a sheltered motorway rest stop at blue hour, viewed from a fixed observer position.
Scene/backdrop: wet roadside rest-stop forecourt, with the route continuing away into low hills.
Subject: quiet road journey atmosphere; only a partial parked truck edge visible at the extreme frame edge, not a focal subject.
Style/medium: rich, cohesive painterly environmental concept art with a polished illustrated finish.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 establishing view, coherent perspective, stable horizon, broad readable spaces and depth; landscape spans the frame.
Lighting/mood: blue-hour dusk, calm and contemplative; amber roadlights recede into distance.
Color palette: deep blue and navy, muted slate, small accents of sodium gold.
Materials/textures: wet dark asphalt with restrained reflections; sheltered rest-stop surfaces and distant road in atmospheric perspective.
Constraints: clean scene plate only, fixed camera; no motion cues that imply camera movement.
Avoid: people, UI, borders, text, letters, numbers, logos, signs with readable content, watermark, visual clutter.

finnish-discoveries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept

Primary request: painterly environmental concept art of a specifically Finnish lakeside sauna at midsummer late evening.

Subject: traditional red-painted Finnish sauna cabin with a subtle warm glow through its window; birches and pier lead the eye to the lake and luminous horizon.
Style/medium: rich, cohesive painterly environmental concept art with naturalistic texture and polished illustrated finish.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 establishing view, coherent perspective, stable horizon, sauna among birches near one side, pier guiding toward calm open water and horizon.
Lighting/mood: quiet midsummer late evening under a glowing pale northern horizon; gentle warm light from sauna window balanced against cool twilight.
Color palette: red timber, birch white and muted green, lake blue-gray, pale peach-gold horizon.
Materials/textures: weathered timber siding, pale birch bark, simple plank pier, calm freshwater shoreline.
Constraints: distinctly Finnish vernacular lakeside sauna setting; clean scene plate, fixed camera.
